title: Mean of the Radon–Nikodym density minus one vanishes
statement:
Let $\mu$ and $
u$ be probability measures on a measurable space $\Omega$, and suppose that $\mu$ is absolutely continuous with respect to $
u$. Writing $ rac{d\mu}{d
u}$ for the Radon–Nikodym density of $\mu$ with respect to $
u$ (the real-valued version of the Radon–Nikodym derivative), one has \[ \int_{\Omega} \left( rac{d\mu}{d
u}(x) - 1ight)\, d
u(x) = 0. \]
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ is absolutely continuous with respect to $\nu$
